mug_yuki: Previous notes correctly identified high volatility between desk_b1 and sink_k1, but today’s 08:12 miss (predicted cupboard_k1, actual kitchen_table_k1) shows the item also circulates through the kitchen table. Do not restrict search to bedroom/kitchen sink axis. Check kitchen_table_k1, desk_b1, and sink_k1 as the primary triad.

water_bottle_yuki: The assumption of a stable morning (desk_b1) vs. afternoon (sink_k1) split is invalid. Today’s 13:51 miss (predicted sink_k1, actual desk_b1) and 21:04 miss (predicted desk_b1, actual dish_rack_k1) prove the bottle moves unpredictably across the house, including to the dish rack. Abandon time-based heuristics entirely. This item is highly volatile; always prioritize the most recent confirmed sighting over any routine pattern.

glass_yuki: The previous pattern of kitchen_table_k1 (evening) and nightstand_b1 (late night) is incorrect. Today’s 22:59 miss (predicted nightstand_b1, actual cupboard_k1) indicates the glass is stored in the cupboard at night. Update the late-night location to cupboard_k1. Do not assume nightstand_b1.

tablet_yuki: No new errors today. Previous note to verify against recent sightings remains valid. Continue to avoid assuming desk_b1.

charger_yuki: No new errors today. Previous note to check nightstand_b1 for late night remains valid.

General Pattern: Yuki’s items are significantly more volatile than previously modeled. The water_bottle_yuki and mug_yuki defy simple time-of-day rules, moving between bedroom, kitchen table, sink, and dish rack unpredictably. The glass_yuki has a specific late-night storage spot in the cupboard. Always prioritize the most recent confirmed location over general trends for all Yuki items.
